Genz Skool | Section: About Genz Skool
Genz Skool - Knowledge Base Source: https://genzskool.com (homepage, /courses, /mentors, /how-it-works, /contact, /enroll and all 8 course pages). Crawled 12 Nov 2026. Tagline: Skills for today. Leaders for tomorrow. Hero line: Learn. Apply. Earn. Genz Skool is a practical skills academy based in Sargodha, Pakistan. It teaches video editing, design, digital marketing, Shopify, TikTok Shop, eBay, TikTok automation and AI automation. Courses are taught by people who run stores, edit for clients and ship automations. The site states there are 8 practical courses, 100% hands-on projects, and lifetime course access. Why Genz Skool (site claims)
- Expert trainers: learn from people who run stores, edit for clients and ship automations.
- Practical learning: 100% practical, every module ends in a real project.
- Certificate: finish lessons and projects to get a Genz Skool certificate for CV, Fiverr or Upwork.
- Career support: guidance on portfolios, freelancing profiles and first clients.
- Lifetime access: rewatch every lesson, forever.
- Trainer credentials claimed on site: Google Partner (ads and marketing), Google Skillshop (training partnership), Meta Blueprint (certified), Adobe Certified (Premiere Pro, Photoshop).

Genz Skool | Section: How it works
- Step 1 Pick a skill: choose from 8 courses. Not sure? An advisor helps on WhatsApp.
- Step 2 Enroll in a batch: fill the enrollment form, pick morning, evening or weekend classes, confirm the seat with an advisor.
- Step 3 Learn by doing: short recorded lessons anytime plus weekly live classes where the mentor works through real projects.
- Step 4 Submit real projects: every module ends with an assignment (a reel, a store, a campaign); the mentor reviews it and says what to fix.
- Step 5 Get certified: finish lessons and projects for a Genz Skool certificate for CV, Fiverr or Upwork.
- Step 6 Start earning: use the portfolio to land clients, launch a store or grow a channel; lifetime access to return anytime.

Genz Skool | Section: Enrollment
- Online form at /enroll, four steps: 1 Your details, 2 Course and batch, 3 Payment, 4 Review.
- Step 1 fields: Full name, WhatsApp number, Email (optional), City, Age group (Prefer not to say, Under 18, 18-24, 25-34, 35+).
- No payment is taken on the website. An advisor confirms seat, batch and fee on WhatsApp.
- Default format shown: recorded lessons plus live classes, online, evening; certificate and lifetime access.
- Fee shown as confirmed on WhatsApp on the enroll page; individual course pages list fees (Section 3).
- Admins can also leave a WhatsApp number on the homepage to receive batch dates and fees.

Genz Skool | Section: FAQ and certificate
Questions listed: How do I enroll? Do I need any experience before I start? Are classes live or recorded? Will I get a certificate? How long do I keep access? What does a course cost? Only one answer was visible in the crawled HTML: Will I get a certificate? Yes. Finish the lessons and submit your projects to get a Genz Skool certificate you can add to your CV, Fiverr or Upwork profile. The other answers are collapsed on the page; the equivalent facts above come from How it works, Enroll and the course pages.

Genz Skool | Section: Known data limitations
- Lesson counts do not match module structure: e.g. Shopify says 24 lessons but lists 4 modules x 3 lessons = 12. Treat the headline lesson count as marketing and do not derive a per-module lesson list.
- Lesson titles beyond the first module are not published. Do not invent a syllabus.
- Testimonials on the site use placeholder names ('Student name'). Do not cite student outcomes or earnings as facts.
- No job-placement, salary or income statistics are published. The advisor must not promise earnings.
- Batch data can be stale: GS-GD-001 is labelled 'Portal Test Batch' and seat counts change. Always tell the user to confirm batches and fees on WhatsApp 0309-4190245.
- TikTok automation has no published fee.
- Age restriction: the form lists an 'Under 18' option; no minimum age rule is published.
